name: Cosmic CRF Ltd
tagline: BSE-SME cold-rolled-form / railway-wagon-component maker with an integrated-wagon roll-up ambition - the Supreme Court has now vacated the NCLAT Section 29A ineligibility finding, materially lifting the biggest overhang
business_overview: Manufacturer of cold-rolled formed sections and railway wagon components for Indian Railways and PSUs, pursuing an 'integrated wagon manufacturer' roll-up (Amzen bid); BSE-SME listed.
fundamentals_table: Supreme Court (2026 INSC 608) allowed Cosmic's appeals, upheld Section 29A eligibility, set aside NCLAT orders
fundamentals_narrative: FY26 was a strong operating year - ~90% volume growth, H2 revenue +~78% and PAT ~2.4x - though margins stayed thin (~10% OPM). The decisive change since the prior read is legal: the Supreme Court has allowed Cosmic's appeals and held it was not disqualified under Section 29A(c)/(j), setting aside the NCLAT ineligibility orders. That removes the single largest bear point. Two items still warrant monitoring: whether FY26 operating/free cash flow turned positive (FY25 was negative despite reported profit), and the status of the third-party forgery allegations against the Cosmic-linked Raft Cosmic EV JV.
sentiment_summary: No new forum activity since the prior read (thread stable, highest #84). The Supreme Court outcome is confirmed via public sources / the Q4 concall ('legal victory'), not via new thread posts.
community_signal: Prior in-thread presence of Manik_Gupta (elevated) was limited to legal-status updates and risk flags; no trusted conviction call, no floor active.
key_new_facts: Sovrenn lead verified: H2 FY26 sales +78% YoY to ~Rs 412 Cr, net profit ~2.4x YoY to ~Rs 26 Cr, OPM ~10% flat; capacity ~133,600 MTPA with ~90% FY26 volume growth.

Supreme Court judgment (2026 INSC 608) allowed Cosmic CRF's appeals, upheld its eligibility under Section 29A, and set aside the NCLAT orders - eligibility to be tested at plan-submission date, no subsisting NPAs/controlling links then.
Raft Cosmic EV JV forgery allegations and FY26 cash-flow quality remain to be re-confirmed.
bull_case: Supreme Court has vacated the NCLAT Section 29A ineligibility finding - the biggest legal overhang is lifted
Strong FY26 operating momentum (~90% volume growth, H2 PAT ~2.4x) into a railway-capex upcycle
Small Rs 795 Cr base with integrated-wagon-manufacturer optionality
bear_case: Thin ~10% OPM / ~6-7% PAT margins; FY25 had negative operating and free cash flow despite reported profit - FY26 cash quality unconfirmed
Third-party forgery allegations against the Cosmic-linked Raft Cosmic EV JV - status unresolved in what I reviewed
SME-scale disclosure quality historically poor (delayed announcements, 'unconvincing' concall answers)
Roll-up execution (Amzen / integrated wagon plant) still unproven
verdict_headline: Re-verification: the Supreme Court has cleared the Section 29A ineligibility finding and FY26 growth is strong - conviction raised to Low-Medium and the HIGH CAUTION tier removed, with cash-flow quality and the EV-JV allegations still to monitor
verdict_reasoning: Re-verification stock (Sovrenn lead). The H2 FY26 growth datapoint is verified, and separately the Supreme Court has set aside the NCLAT Section 29A orders and upheld Cosmic's eligibility - the primary driver of the earlier HIGH CAUTION tier is gone.

With the apex-court cloud lifted, ~90% FY26 volume growth, a railway-capex upcycle and a small Rs 795 Cr base, conviction moves up one notch to Low-Medium; the red_flag_tier is cleared to null, with the Raft Cosmic EV-JV allegations and the historically weak cash flow named as the remaining watch items.

thesis_fit stays 10x-in-2-3-years, still substantially optionality-driven (integrated-wagon roll-up). No 30-day revisit (conviction below Medium-High). Re-check FY26 operating/free cash flow and the EV-JV allegation status.

value_chain.theme: railway capex upcycle - wagons and rolling-stock components
value_chain.position: cold-rolled formed sections + wagon components supplier to Indian Railways/PSUs, moving toward integrated wagon manufacturing
value_chain.bottleneck_node: wagon build slots / integrated wagon capacity
value_chain.note: Railway wagon demand is in an upcycle and Cosmic is adding capacity into it; the integrated-wagon step-up is the swing factor, but it competes with far larger established wagon builders.

four_box.note: Railway-capex upcycle for wagons/rolling-stock is a real structural tailwind; small base (~Rs795cr) + roll-up optionality (Amzen/integrated wagon plant) is unproven execution — tam weak; no distinct moat vs peers (Titagarh, Jupiter Wagons) — weak; no valuation data, thin ~10% OPM and unconfirmed FY26 cash quality — weak. Supreme Court vacating the NCLAT Section 29A ineligibility is a major cleared overhang; Raft Cosmic EV-JV forgery allegations remain unresolved.
